sahneler.metin: As it left port in Georgia, a giant car carrier suddenly rolled onto its side.
Crew were trapped inside for more than a day before being rescued.
The ship carried thousands of cars.
Ballast data had been entered incorrectly.
In a normal turn, the ship heeled too far to recover.
The wreck was cut into giant slices to remove it.
The operator changed how stability is checked before departure.

aciklama:
Golden Ray capsized as it left port in Georgia. The cause: insufficient stability from an incorrect ballast calculation.
